items.q: Do you work in my country?
items.a: Yes! 🌎 We work with businesses in Colombia, Chile, Mexico, the US and any other country. Everything is done online and your assistant works on your same number, wherever you are.

It depends on your country and what you need: we adjust the price to your currency and your market, so it isn't the same everywhere. Leave your details and we'll send your quote within 24 hours, no strings attached.

items.q: Do I need to know about technology?
items.a: No. We set everything up. You just tell us how your business works.

items.q: Do I lose my WhatsApp number?

items.q: What if the assistant doesn't know something?

items.q: Do I lose my number or my WhatsApp?
items.a: No. You keep the same number and the same WhatsApp Business app on your phone. You see every chat, including the assistant's replies, and you can write whenever you want.

items.q: What if the assistant gets it wrong?
items.a: It only answers with the information you give it. If it doesn't know, it doesn't make it up: it passes it to you. Complaints and health topics come straight to you. We test it with you before launch and review the conversations in the first week.

items.q: Will my clients know it's an assistant?
items.a: If someone asks, it says it's your business's virtual assistant and offers to hand the chat to a person. You can reply at any time and the assistant steps aside in that chat.

items.q: Do I have to take deposits?
items.a: No. Deposits are optional. If you don't take them, the assistant books and confirms right away. If you do, it holds the slot and you confirm the payment with one tap.

items.q: Does it work with Fresha, Square or Booksy?
items.a: Today the assistant books into Google Calendar, with one calendar per staff member that you can see on your phone. If your bookings live in another system, let's talk first to see if it fits.
Meta charges for the messages the assistant sends, like reminders, directly to your business card. It's usually a few dollars a month. Conversations your clients start are free.
Yes. There's a 3-month minimum, then 30 days' notice. Your number, calendars and client data are yours: we hand them over or delete them, as you prefer.
